fullDesc: On April 19, 1775 British soldiers and colonial militia clashed at Lexington and Concord in Massachusetts. The fighting began the American Revolutionary War, often remembered as the shot heard round the world.
realFacts: Paul Revere and others rode to warn of the British march
The Declaration of Independence followed in 1776
France joined the American side in 1778
The war ended with the Treaty of Paris in 1783
